title: Take It From Here: Evaluating Coding Agents On Project Takeover
abstract: arXiv:2611.07307v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coding agents increasingly collaborate on long-term projects. When taking over a project, they need to recover currently applicable requirements from the interaction history and update them in response to new requests. However, most coding benchmarks do not include long interaction histories, and some evaluations that consider history still do not cover the full process from requirement reconstruction to project delivery. We therefore provide agents with the interaction history, current request, and pre-request project environment, ask them to make the requested changes, and assess takeover performance through delivery tests. Across six model-harness configurations and 37 targets eligible for executable validation, the mean complete-delivery rate under Full History is only 4.95%. We then use requirement atoms to independently diagnose a larger set of takeover targets, examining relevant information identification, pre-request state recon

translated_title: 从这里接手：评估编程智能体的项目接管能力
translated_abstract: 编程智能体越来越多地在长期项目中协同工作。在接管项目时，它们需要从交互历史中恢复当前适用的需求，并根据新请求对这些需求进行更新。然而，大多数编程基准测试不包含较长的交互历史，而一些考虑了历史的评估也未能覆盖从需求重构到项目交付的完整流程。因此，我们为智能体提供交互历史、当前请求以及请求前的项目环境，要求它们完成所请求的更改，并通过交付测试来评估其接管性能。在六种模型-框架配置以及37个可进行可执行验证的目标中，完整历史条件下的平均完整交付率仅为4.95%。随后，我们使用需求原子对更大规模的接管目标进行独立诊断，考察相关信息识别、请求前状态重构等方面……
tldr: 该论文提出了评估编程智能体项目接管能力的新基准，发现即使提供完整交互历史，智能体的平均完整交付率也仅为4.95%，揭示了当前智能体在从历史中恢复需求并完成项目交付方面的严重不足。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a new benchmark for evaluating coding agents' project takeover ability, finding that even with full interaction history, agents achieve only a 4.95% mean complete-delivery rate, revealing severe deficiencies in recovering requirements from history and completing project delivery.
